# Implementation Plan: Hello World Webpage

**Branch**: `master` | **Date**: 2026-05-19 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `specs/001-hello-world-webpage/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by the `/speckit.plan` command on 2026-05-19.

## Summary

Create a static Hello World webpage that displays centered content (heading "Hello, World!" and introductory paragraph) with a clickable button that shows a confirmation message. Delivers a single-file HTML/CSS/JavaScript application loadable directly via file:// protocol with no external dependencies or build tools.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: HTML5, CSS3, ES6 JavaScript

**Primary Dependencies**: None (vanilla web platform)

**Storage**: N/A

**Testing**: Manual browser testing via file:// protocol

**Target Platform**: Modern web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

**Project Type**: Static webpage

**Performance Goals**: Instant load (local file delivery)

**Constraints**: Single HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript; no build tools or frameworks

**Scale/Scope**: Single page with three content elements and one interactive button
